name: Create detailed descriptions of fused fictional character pairs
description: Users asked to generate detailed descriptions of fictional fusion characters created by merging traits, appearances, and abilities from two or more existing source characters. The requests frequently emphasized extensiveness by requesting head-to-toe anatomical breakdowns, specific attire, and combined personality profiles, often focusing on androgynous or hermaphroditic physical features.
